decision_rule: Corrected = the value adds a fact the cited page does not show, tags a judgement as stated (incl. site-attribution or single-site judgements and self-named parents contradicted by a registry), places a company-level fact at the plant, ties a fact to the plant through a city shared by several sites (campus rule), or the quote is not on the page (raw source incl. JSON-LD checked first); also an inferred relationship or tier that breaks the written mining relationship rule or the CLAUDE.md tier definitions. Unreachable = cited page cannot be opened today by any route (never confirmed). Confirmed otherwise. Not additive: limiting labels ('company-level', 'company-wide', '(company product list)'), as-of dates, provenance labels. A full compound value repeated on several rows is confirmed when each row's page carries its clause and the rows together carry the whole value (PPI precedent). Self-named parent rows are confirmed by precedent (Metalcraft, Klein) unless a cited registry record shows another filer. OSHA rows checked against data/osha_2025.csv by record ID and the osha_match.py gates. One test for site placement: a value that ties a fact to the site is stated only when the cited page itself names the place as where the work happens (E-Z Drill 'manufacture our machines in a 22,000-square-foot facility in Perry'; Meeker 'Belleville ... our home ... our manufacturing facility where we make'); a page that only says the company is located or 'growing' there (CMP) makes the tie a judgement. OSHA headcount rows are stated when the record passes the brief's gates (ZIP, street number, street name, operating name); a duplicate filing by the same company with the same count is not an ambiguity (PMM). Dated statements shown as current are corrected to carry their date (kind other; Mixer/MICA precedent).
